note: Modules generated from xls/*.x. See doc/xls.md. Every module is scheduled by XLS against the asap7 delay model at the same 1300 ps target; stage counts are the minimum that meets it, measured with `make xls-report`.

modules.why: All-pairs conversion among the five formats: a widen and a narrow in series, which is why it needs one more stage than narrow alone.

Narrow format to binary32. Exact by construction, so no rounding logic, and its 1005 ps asap7 path fits the 1300 ps target with no flops at all -- which is what lets tnca_fpu_multi put it in front of the FMA without adding a cycle.
binary32 to a narrow format. This half carries the rounding, saturation and subnormal generation for four target formats, and is 3476 ps combinational, so it is the half that has to be pipelined.
Widen two narrow operands to binary32 for the matrix unit. No arithmetic: apfloat flushes subnormals and this ISA does not. Combinational for the same reason as tnca_widen_xls.
SFU exp2: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22.
SFU log2: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22.
SFU rcp: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22. Seven stages, not the six this one alone needs, so all four SFU operations share a latency.
SFU rsqrt: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22. Seven stages, not the six this one alone needs, so all four SFU operations share a latency.
